Reading your fragment as a question about the health effects of a low-carbohydrate diet: for most healthy adults it is safe short to medium term and often aids weight loss and blood sugar control. Very low intake can cause fatigue, headache, and constipation in the first weeks, and can leave gaps in fiber and some micronutrients unless the diet is planned well. Long-term effects are still debated, so people with diabetes on medication, kidney disease, or other conditions should check with a clinician first.
